newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Mar 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Mar 17.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Monday:
* President Clinton's planned summit meeting with Russian President Boris Yeltsin in Helsinki this week has been delayed by one day because of the U.S. President's knee injury.
* Jordan's King Hussein visited the families of seven Israeli schoolgirls killed by a Jordanian soldier while visiting shared land in the Jordan Valley.
* As rebel soldiers marched into Kisangani, Zaire, thousands of people expressed solidarity with them and celebrated the departure of government troops.
* News Analysis: Rumors that Zaire's ruler Mobutu Sese Seko has died are evidence of the prevailing belief that his long reign is nearly over.
* The New England region has once again pulled itself together and is experiencing an economic rebirth, founded on entrepreneurial high-tech ventures and services.
* All things Irish are in demand, spawning Irish village theme bars in New York City, memoirs and movies.
